page_title: JUV 0-0 NAP | Juventus v Napoli 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' David Neres (Napoli) takes the corner but it's cleared.
90+4' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from David Neres (Napoli). Napoli get a corner.
90+1' The move breaks down when Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) attempts an ambitious shot from distance that goes well wide of the right post.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

88' Timothy Weah (Juventus) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Juventus are going to take it.
88' Michael Folorunsho (Napoli) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
87' Substitution. Billy Gilmour (Napoli) on for Stanislav Lobotka.
85' David Neres (Napoli) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.

83' Teun Koopmeiners sends a slide-rule pass into the feet of Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus), who without a second thought fires a shot in on goal from mid-range which only goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
81' Michael Folorunsho (Napoli) trips an opposition player and Daniele Doveri signals a foul.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Weston McKennie trots off the pitch and is replaced by Khephren Thuram (Juventus).
79' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles wide of the right post. Nice run, but poor finish!
77' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
76' Nicolo Savona (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Juventus win a corner.
75' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:2.
74' David Neres (Napoli) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
73' Michael Folorunsho (Napoli) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matteo Politano.
73' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia walks off the pitch to be replaced by David Neres (Napoli).
72' Antonio Conte prepares a substitution. Romelu Lukaku is replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).

70' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
69' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
68' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Doveri had a clear view and blows his whistle.
68' Nicolo Savona (Juventus) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
66' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
65' The game is interrupted now, Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
62' Scott McTominay (Napoli) tries to find Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
61' Matteo Politano (Napoli) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
60' Matteo Politano (Napoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
59' The ball is cleared after Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
58' Thiago Motta (Juventus) says something out of turn to the referee and is shown a yellow card.
55' Matteo Politano (Napoli) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but it's just a bit too high and misses the bar by a whisker.
54' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle as Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
51' Great teamplay by Juventus as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
49' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Alex Meret easily deals with the threat.
48' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
46' Half-time substitution. Thiago Motta decided to make a change. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is replaced by Timothy Weah.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

45+2' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) jumps into a tackle and Daniele Doveri signals a foul.
44' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
42' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
41' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniele Doveri no option but to blow his whistle.
40' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

40' A cross from Nicolo Savona (Juventus) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul after Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) hacks down one of his opponents.
38' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
36' Antonio Conte is forced to make a change. Alex Meret is unable to continue due to injury, Elia Caprile (Napoli) comes on.
35' Alex Meret (Napoli) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
34' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Weston McKennie (Juventus) was quite harsh and Daniele Doveri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
33' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:1.
32' Dusan Vlahovic receives a short pass from Weston McKennie (Juventus), but the opposition's defence thwarts his effort.
31' Good defending. Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) tries to find Khvicha Kvaratskhelia inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
30' A lofted cross from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
29' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
29' Scott McTominay (Napoli) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Michele Di Gregorio makes a smart save to deny him.
28' Romelu Lukaku almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
27' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Dusan Vlahovic, but Alex Meret displays great awareness to stop him.

26' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.
25' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Meret, who smothers the ball.
22' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Juventus comes to nothing.

22' Weston McKennie (Juventus) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Good work from Juventus as they win a corner.
21' The ball falls to Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) on the edge of the box, but his shot goes well wide of the goal.
21' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
20' Napoli are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession. Napoli will take a corner kick.
19' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle and it's Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
19' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
17' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
16' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
15' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
13' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
11' Matteo Politano (Napoli) makes a slide tackle, but referee Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
10' Nicolo Savona (Juventus) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
7' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
4' Matteo Politano (Napoli) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
3' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Napoli.
2' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Napoli will take the kick-off.
Daniele Doveri will officiate today.
